name: Ts’ao Tsu
bio: Ts’ao Tsu (曹組; Cao Zu; 12th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 蓦山溪 (Mo shan xi)
poems.author: Ts’ao Tsu
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
洗妆真态，不作铅华御。
竹外一枝斜，想佳人、天寒日暮。
黄昏小院，无处著清香，风细细，雪垂垂，何况江头路。
月边疏影，梦到消魂处。
结子欲黄时，又须著、廉纤细雨。
孤芳一世，供断有情愁，销瘦却，东阳也，试问花知否。
